blocks.text: SINGAPORE — Bank records presented in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial would be difficult to dispute unless there is evidence of tampering, Palace press officer Claire Castro said on Wednesday. Castro, a lawyer, was asked about the evidentiary weight of bank records after financial documents involving Duterte and her husband, Manases Carpio, were presented before the Senate impeachment court. “The bank accounts presented by the bank representatives themselves have a significant impact and carry substantial value,” Castro told reporters at the Philippine embassy in Singapore. “Bank records do not lie,” she added.
